scope: Read-only source investigation of numeric literal underflow; no engine patch or production SQL rewrite
observations: Without MODE_DOUBLE_LITERAL, scientific notation is parsed as BigDecimal unless integer part exceeds 38 digits.
DecimalLiteral.init bounds decimal scale to at most 76 and rounds; values below that scale can become zero before an outer DOUBLE cast.
A text-to-DOUBLE cast retains the intended floating-point input in live comparison.
implication: Typed floating filter/compiler lowering must retain DOUBLE semantics before engine literal rounding. Do not globally enable double literals because exact decimal expressions also depend on this mode.
remaining: Validate typed filter lowering and document semantic literal policy before numeric query acceptance.
